scripts.title: Auto QTE
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
local QTE_UI = {
    ['Normal'] = PlayerGui.Main.QTE,
    ['Toma'] = PlayerGui.Main.QTEToma,
    ['XSaw'] = PlayerGui.Main.QTEXSaw,
}

-- felt like adding console support
-- not tested btw
local UI_TO_CONSOLEVK = {
    ['rbxassetid://13352945562'] = 0xC3,
    ['rbxassetid://15106210189'] = 0xC3, 

    ['rbxassetid://13352947210'] = 0xC4, 
    ['rbxassetid://15106208667'] = 0xC4, 

    ['rbxassetid://13352956569'] = 0xC6, 
    ['rbxassetid://15106213231'] = 0xC6,

    ['rbxassetid://13352960244'] = 0xC5, 
    ['rbxassetid://15106212286'] = 0xC5, 

    ['rbxassetid://13352968794'] = 0xCB,
    ['rbxassetid://15106217179'] = 0xCB,
}

local KEYCODE_TO_VK = {
    ['R'] = 0x52,
    ['E'] = 0x45,
    ['T'] = 0x54,
    ['G'] = 0x47,
    ['F'] = 0x46,
}

local function init(ui)
    local button = ui.ImageButton
    ui:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'):Connect(function()
        -- reason why im doing this becaust just incase YOU plug in a keyboard port or gamepad port
        -- to your phone or tablet idk
        if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
            repeat
                firesignal(button.MouseButton1Click)
                task.wait(0.07)
            until not ui.Visible
        else
            local key

            if not UserInputService.GamepadEnabled then
                key = button.PC
            elseif UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) == 'ButtonCross' then
                key = button.Playstation
            else
                key = button.Xbox
            end

            repeat
                if not key then break end
                if key.Name == 'PC' then
                    local keycode = KEYCODE_TO_VK[key.Text]
                    if keycode then
                        keytap(keycode)
                    end
                else
                    local keycode = UI_TO_CONSOLEVK[key.Image]
                    if keycode then
                        keytap(keycode)
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.07)
            until not ui.Visible
        end
    end)
end
for _, ui in QTE_UI do
    task.spawn(init, ui)
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--//==================================================
--// SETTINGS
--//==================================================

local messages = {}

local autoRandomEnabled = false
local AUTO_RANDOM_DELAY = 5
local lastRandomIndex = nil

local uiScale = 1
local transparency = 0

local accentColor = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 62)

-- Floating quick sentences
local quickSentencesEnabled = true
local quickConfig = {}
-- quickConfig["message"] = {
--     x = number,
--     y = number,
--     locked = boolean
-- }

local quickFrames = {}
local quickDragConnections = {}

local SAVE_FILE = "ChatSenderYe_Messages.json"
local SETTINGS_FILE = "ChatSenderYe_Settings.json"

--//==================================================
--// REMOVE OLD GUI IF SCRIPT IS RAN AGAIN
--//==================================================

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ChatSenderYe_UPD")

if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

--//==================================================
--// FILE FUNCTIONS
--//==================================================

local function loadMessages()
	if isfile and readfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
		local success, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
		end)

		if success and type(data) == "table" then
			messages = {}

			for _, message in ipairs(data) do
				if type(message) == "string" and message ~= "" then
					table.insert(messages, message)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function saveMessages()
	if writefile then
		pcall(function()
			writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(messages))
		end)
	end
end

local function loadSettings()
	if isfile and readfile and isfile(SETTINGS_FILE) then
		local success, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SETTINGS_FILE))
		end)

		if success and type(data) == "table" then

			if tonumber(data.uiScale) then
				uiScale = math.clamp(tonumber(data.uiScale), 0.7, 1.4)
			end

			if tonumber(data.transparency) then
				transparency = math.clamp(tonumber(data.transparency), 0, 0.7)
			end

			if type(data.quickSentencesEnabled) == "boolean" then
				quickSentencesEnabled = data.quickSentencesEnabled
			end

			if type(data.quickConfig) == "table" then
				quickConfig = {}

				for message, config in pairs(data.quickConfig) do
					if type(message) == "string" and type(config) == "table" then

						quickConfig[message] = {
							x = tonumber(config.x) or 10,
							y = tonumber(config.y) or 150,
							locked = config.locked == true
						}

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function saveSettings()
	if writefile then
		pcall(function()
			writefile(
				SETTINGS_FILE,
				HttpService:JSONEncode({
					uiScale = uiScale,
					transparency = transparency,
					quickSentencesEnabled = quickSentencesEnabled,
					quickConfig = quickConfig
				})
			)
		end)
	end
end

loadMessages()
loadSettings()

--//==================================================
--// HELPERS
--//==================================================

local function messageExists(message)
	for _, savedMessage in ipairs(messages) do
		if savedMessage == message then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function getDefaultQuickPosition(index)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	local x = 10
	local y = 120 + ((index - 1) * 50)

	if camera then
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

		if y > viewport.Y - 55 then
			y = 100
		end
	end

	return x, y
end

local function clampQuickPosition(frame, x, y)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return x, y
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

	local maxX = math.max(0, viewport.X - frame.AbsoluteSize.X)
	local maxY = math.max(0, viewport.Y - frame.AbsoluteSize.Y)

	return math.clamp(x, 0, maxX),
		math.clamp(y, 0, maxY)
end

--//==================================================
--// SEND MESSAGE
--//==================================================

local function sendMessage(message)
	if not message or message == "" then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")

		if channels then
			local general = channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

			if general then
				general:SendAsync(message)
			end
		end
	end)
end

--//==================================================

--//==================================================
--// MAIN DRAG FUNCTION
--//==================================================

local function makeDraggable(object, dragArea)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	dragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPosition = object.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		object.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

local function clearQuickDragConnections(frame)
	local connections = quickDragConnections[frame]

	if connections then
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
	end

	quickDragConnections[frame] = nil
end

createQuickMini = function(message, index)
	if not quickSentencesEnabled then
		return
	end

	if not quickConfig[message] then
		local x, y = getDefaultQuickPosition(index)

		quickConfig[message] = {
			x = x,
			y = y,
			locked = false
		}

		saveSettings()
	end

	local config = quickConfig[message]

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Quick_" .. tostring(index)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 42)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		config.x or 10,
		config.y or 120
	)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(transparency, 0, 0.7)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Active = true
	frame.ZIndex = 30
	frame.Parent = gui

	Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

	quickFrames[message] = frame

	-- Sentence button

	local sendButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	sendButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 1, 0)
	sendButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	sendButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	sendButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)

	sendButton.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	sendButton.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	sendButton.ZIndex = 31
	sendButton.Parent = frame

	local textPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	textPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
	textPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
	textPadding.Parent = sendButton

	-- Lock

	local lockButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	lockButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 34)
	lockButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 4)
	lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
	lockButton.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	lockButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lockButton.Text = config.locked and "🔒" or "🔓"
	lockButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235)
	lockButton.TextSize = 14
	lockButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	lockButton.ZIndex = 32
	lockButton.Parent = frame

	Instance.new("UICorner", lockButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

	-- Remove floating button

	local removeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	removeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 34)
	removeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 4)
	removeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
	removeButton.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	removeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	removeButton.Text = "×"
	removeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80)
	removeButton.TextSize = 19
	removeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	removeButton.ZIndex = 32
	removeButton.Parent = frame

	Instance.new("UICorner", removeButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

	-- Send

	sendButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		sendMessage(message)
	end)

	-- Lock/unlock

	lockButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		config.locked = not config.locked

		if config.locked then
			lockButton.Text = "🔒"
		else
			lockButton.Text = "🔓"
		end

		saveSettings()
	end)

	-- Remove floating version only

	removeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		quickConfig[message] = nil

		clearQuickDragConnections(frame)

		quickFrames[message] = nil

		frame:Destroy()

		saveSettings()
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- DRAGGING
	--==================================================

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput = nil
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPosition = nil

	local c1 = sendButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if config.locked then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPosition = frame.Position
		end
	end)

	local c2 = sendButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	local c3 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input ~= dragInput then
			return
		end

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
		local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

		newX, newY = clampQuickPosition(frame, newX, newY)

		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
	end)

	local c4 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false

			config.x = frame.Position.X.Offset
			config.y = frame.Position.Y.Offset

			saveSettings()
		end
	end)

	quickDragConnections[frame] = {
		c1,
		c2,
		c3,
		c4
	}
end

refreshQuickMinis = function()
	-- Remove old floating buttons

	for message, frame in pairs(quickFrames) do
		clearQuickDragConnections(frame)

		if frame then
			frame:Destroy()
		end

		quickFrames[message] = nil
	end

	if not quickSentencesEnabled then
		return
	end

	local seen = {}
	local index = 0

	for _, message in ipairs(messages) do
		if quickConfig[message] and not seen[message] then
			seen[message] = true
			index += 1

			createQuickMini(message, index)
		end
	end
end

		Instance.new("UICorner", deleteButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

		-- Send normally

		messageButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			sendMessage(message)
		end)

		-- Create floating quick sentence

		quickButton.Activated:Connect(function()

			if quickConfig[message] then
				-- Already exists: just make sure it is visible
				quickSentencesEnabled = true
				updateQuickToggle()
				refreshQuickMinis()
				saveSettings()
				return

			local x, y = getDefaultQuickPosition(index)

			quickSentencesEnabled = true

		-- Delete saved sentence

		deleteButton.Activated:Connect(function()

			-- Also remove its floating version
			quickConfig[message] = nil

			for i = #messages, 1, -1 do
				if messages[i] == message then
					table.remove(messages, i)
					break
				end
			end

			saveMessages()
			saveSettings()

			refreshMessages()
			refreshQuickMinis()
		end)
	end

local function addMessage()
	local text = inputBox.Text

	if not text or text == "" then
		return
	end

	text = text:gsub("^%s+", "")
	text = text:gsub("%s+$", "")

	if text == "" then
		return
	end

	table.insert(messages, text)

	inputBox.Text = ""

	saveMessages()
	refreshMessages()
end
